summary: No synchronized multi-person implementation or eligible MultiRep artifact exists; write only a method/protocol scaffold with visibly pending empirical controls.

claims.revision: We propose an identity-indexed local-tempo counter; its implementation remains synchronization-pending.
The intended counting objective is designed not to use person-wise count or period annotations; this remains unaudited, and pose/tracking supervision must be disclosed.
MultiRep effectiveness and competitiveness remain to be evaluated under the preregistered protocol.
We preregister ablations and a piecewise time-warp diagnostic to test routing, reconstruction, and any implemented continuity mechanism.
Existing local UCFRep dev84, proxy, and smoke outputs are diagnostic only and are excluded from ICASSP result tables.
